column1: # Every picture and font a store package may carry (plan T3.8): <sha256> TAB <path in the package> TAB <what it shows>.
# build/check-artefacts.mjs refuses a package holding any picture or font not named here with its hash. A new or changed
# picture is opened and looked at, then its line added (or the picture replaced in assets/, or left out in patch 0003).
# Pictures that showed Bitwarden's shield or wordmark are replaced (assets/MANIFEST) or left out; none is listed here.
# A picture or font embedded in a text file as a data: URL is listed as <file>#embedded, by the sha256 of its decoded bytes.
